name: Free Mocap Pack 09: Basketball (Anderson Rohr)
summary: 23 basketball motion-capture animations (~4 minutes total, 60 fps): dribbles, passes, defense, blocks, layup, jump shots, dunks, free throw, three-pointer. Captured with Rokoko and cleaned in Rokoko Studio, delivered as FBX for three skeletons: Rokoko Default, Reallusion iClone and UE5 Manny. Part of a series of free mocap packs.

access.license: Anderson Rohr free mocap pack terms (on Gumroad page)
access.notes: Free for personal and commercial projects, attribution not required. No redistribution, resale or repackaging as a standalone product. Delivered through Gumroad checkout.

procedure: Enter 0 (or any amount) in the price field and add to cart.
Complete the Gumroad checkout to receive the download link.
Import the FBX matching your rig (Rokoko Default, iClone or UE5 Manny).

verdict.why: Clean sports mocap retargeted to three common skeletons, free with commercial use and no attribution required. Minus: Gumroad checkout step, FBX only, small pack.
